original_test_intent: Validate the Type 39 Manufacturer string for each supply against its approved physical/OEM identity, including allowed aliases, and confirm stable reporting after reboot.
original_method: Resolve and preserve every Manufacturer string reference, bind it to a stable supply identity, compare exact/normalized text with the owner-approved manufacturer and alias set, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies authoritative manufacturer identities, alias rules and reboot approval; the core check is read-only software comparison.
required_inputs: Expected manufacturer per supply or FRU identity and allowed OEM/brand aliases
Case, whitespace and normalization policy plus empty/duplicate handling
SMBIOS version, Type 39 string parser and read-only inventory source
safety_requirements: Do not remove or switch PSUs to identify the manufacturer.
Retain exact string bytes before alias normalization and validate the string index.
Bind comparisons to a stable supply/FRU identity, not row order.
Stop on power or management degradation; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve each Manufacturer reference, retain exact/normalized text, correlate it to approved inventory and evaluate aliases before/after reboot.
Report dangling, empty, unexpected, duplicated or drifting values without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve authoritative manufacturer/alias mapping and reboot plan.
Decide whether OEM branding differences are acceptable and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is correct, but grep omits raw index integrity, per-supply ownership and alias policy.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive all raw/decoded Type 39 and string tables; emit supply identity, index, exact manufacturer, normalized alias result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Manufacturer scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained without physical supply actions.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate each raw string reference, preserve exact text, bind it to PSU identity and compare through a finite owner-approved alias table across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Manufacturer string definition plus approved PSU/FRU inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw reference validation, identity binding and controlled alias matching.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong-record values and rejects arbitrary non-empty/OEM-like strings while accepting documented branding aliases.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: FRU and SMBIOS may use different brand/legal names; only explicitly approved equivalences are valid.

project_override_considerations: Projects may approve vendor aliases or normalization, but must preserve the exact firmware string and the identity-specific mapping used.
expected_evidence: Approved manufacturer/alias map and identity baseline
Complete pre-reboot Type 39 handles, raw indices and exact Manufacturer strings
Per-supply inventory correlation and alias decision
Statement that no PSU was manipulated
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot exact/normalized diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Manufacturer is a defined Type 39 string field; OEM alias policy is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String integrity, identity correlation and finite alias matching are automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw reference, stable identity and explicit OEM alias semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its evidence and safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps missing alias/baseline/reboot data in readiness and verdict ownership.

review_improvement: Prevents both false acceptance of arbitrary manufacturer text and false rejection of documented OEM branding aliases.
independent_technical_reasoning: A manufacturer string is correct only for a specific supply identity and an approved alias set; formatting alone does not establish either relationship.
